commitments.detail: Used oil drums will be disposed of according to environmental regulations.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned for proper disposal.
Used oil drums will be transported to the local hazardous waste facility for proper disposal.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to the original manufacturer or supplier for recycling or proper disposal.
Vehicle batteries and empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by the base maintenance shop for reuse or recycling.
Used oil drums will be transported to the local waste management facility for proper disposal.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to the supply chain management office for reuse.
Vehicle batteries and empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by the base maintenance shop for further processing.
